decision: Do not port legacy SyncContext wholesale. Its foreign-event import, durable cursor policy and all-or-none multi-event transaction are unresolved and its separate StateStore would violate single canonical state ownership. Safe next slice is adapter design that uses SyncDispatcher/SQLiteStateStore as the only authority; requires an explicit transport contract and import-side SQLite schema before runtime implementation.
